vibe_rationale: Loyal camping community, but a single-brand owners' gathering rather than an open culture festival, so brand-owned and narrower than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Outdoor-living crowd with a strong brand community, though family camping makes the audience mixed-age. Snow Peak owns the event, so only a co-brand invitation would work, though beverage and food partners (Suntory, Nestle Japan, Starbucks) already appear. Attendance comes from secondary sources only.
